_meta.purpose: Maps customer needs (from discovery) to the specific product features that serve them, so the pitch is need -> benefit, not a feature dump. Used by the shortlister (ranking) and the LLM (pitch wording).
_meta.source: Derived only from cards.json key_benefits / pitch_line / ideal_for (which quote the official brochures). 'topic' points to sections/<product_id>.json for the exact wording to load when the customer asks for detail.
rules: Pitch a feature only if it appears here or in the product's card/sections.
Say 'if declared' / 'not guaranteed' whenever a feature is marked guaranteed=false.
'gate' conditions are applied in code before shortlisting; never speak the gate figure as a price.
'soft_gate' conditions only lower the ranking; they never exclude a product.

loan_cover.label: Make sure my loans don't fall on my family

growing_responsibilities.label: Cover that grows as life changes (marriage, children, home)

premium_back.label: Protection, but I don't want to 'lose' my premiums

lump_sum_goal.label: A lump sum for a known goal (child's education or marriage, a corpus)

lifelong_legacy.label: Lifelong cover and something to leave for my children
listen_for: bachchon ke liye chhod ke jaana
